Hamas dissolves Gaza governing body, paving way for new administration

The Hamas governing body in the Gaza Strip has been dissolved after nearly two decades, clearing the way for a technocratic committee to assume civilian administration. The move is seen as a step towards reform and more efficient governance. However, questions remain about the impact on the region's stability and the future of Palestinian rule.
